single_product.title: JEAN WAX//001 - 60 WAXED JEAN

specs.detail_2: Patch en cuir gravé signature WEARHOUSE 60 à la ceinture

single_product.description_fr: Un denim pèsant 14 oz (475 g/m²), plus lourd et résistant qu'un jean classique. Traitement ciré artisanal offrant des reflets marbrés et un brillant irrégulier unique à chaque pièce. Revers intérieur imprimé camo iconique visible lorsqu'il est retroussé. Patch ceinture gravé avec la signature manuscrite de la marque. Édition limitée à 50 pièces.

header.guidelines: Display logo image, navigation links, cart drawer trigger with item badge, military green accent border.

hero.guidelines: High impact brand statement 'WEAR IT OR DIE FOR IT', showcase WAX//001 editorial assets, prompt buy action.

product_section.guidelines: Editorial gallery view with front/back/editorial/flat photos, size selector (Taille 1, 2, 3), real backend stock status, price display (99.99€ vs 110€ original), add to cart button.

cart_drawer.guidelines: Show selected sizes, quantities, real price calculation in EUR, instant Stripe Sandbox checkout trigger.

admin_panel.guidelines: Real backend inventory control for total stock (50 items) and sizes (17/17/16 breakdown).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user interaction buttons and input elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='size-select-1').
Preserve French editorial wording exactly. Do not add fake customer reviews, newsletter popups, fake stock timers, or fictitious social links.
Use exact image URLs provided in image_urls section without modification or substitution.
Maintain high-contrast dark theme with military dark green accents (#2B3A26, #3E4E35).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All components must be written in Javascript (.js / .jsx). Ensure seamless responsive layout with mobile-first CSS using Tailwind scale.
